tasks.title: Enable nullable annotations for the remaining NtfsAudit.Core model classes
evidence: The other files in src/NtfsAudit.Core/Models do not use local #nullable enable.
impact: Nullability intent is inconsistent across the shared model layer.
Future model changes can introduce null-handling regressions without compiler assistance.
recommended_action: Add local #nullable enable to the remaining model files or move the model slice to an equivalent project/namespace-level nullable setting.
Resolve resulting warnings with accurate annotations or narrow, justified suppressions.
acceptance: Each listed model file has local #nullable enable or the model slice is covered by an equivalent project or namespace-level nullable setting.
Nullable warnings introduced by the model slice are resolved with accurate annotations or justified suppressions.
No runtime behavior, archive format, credential serialization, or public data shape changes are introduced.

tasks.deploy_considered: not applicable; repository has no evidenced external deploy workflow

tasks.title: Prevent .ntaudit archive overwrite when multiple roots share the same leaf name
evidence: src/NtfsAudit.Core/Services/ScanBatchExecutionService.cs builds per-root archive names from the root leaf plus DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy_MM_dd_HH_mm").
src/NtfsAudit.Service/ScanWorker.cs uses the same leaf-plus-minute pattern for service-mode archive output.
Two roots such as C:\DeptA\Share and D:\DeptB\Share processed in the same minute resolve to the same archive filename under the same output directory.
impact: A later root can overwrite an earlier .ntaudit archive in local batch mode or service mode.
The UI/service can report completion while one expected per-root archive is missing.
recommended_action: Introduce a small shared helper that returns a unique archive path by appending a numeric suffix when the candidate file already exists.
Use the helper in local batch export and service-mode export.
Add a focused test that proves two same-leaf roots produce two distinct archive paths.
acceptance: When the first candidate .ntaudit path already exists, the next export uses a suffix such as _2 before the extension.
Existing default filename format remains unchanged when there is no collision.
Local batch and service-mode export use the same uniqueness behavior.
tasks.packaging_considered: not applicable; no package layout change expected
tasks.deploy_considered: not applicable; repository has no evidenced external deploy workflow
compatibility_notes: No archive schema change is required; only output path selection changes.

tasks.title: Handle background batch-scan exceptions instead of leaving them on the fire-and-forget Task
evidence: src/NtfsAudit.App/ViewModels/MainViewModel.ScanExecution.cs starts Task.Run(() => ExecuteBatchScan(...)) without awaiting or attaching a continuation.
ExecuteBatchScan has a finally block for UI state but no catch block for exceptions thrown by ScanBatchExecutionService.Execute before or outside ExecuteScan.
Cancellation before a root scan and unexpected createRootOptions/merge/export failures can fault the background task without a user-facing error path.
impact: The UI can leave only generic state cleanup while the actual failure is not surfaced in ProgressText or a dialog.
Unexpected batch-level failures are harder to diagnose because they bypass the existing scan error message path.
recommended_action: Add explicit OperationCanceledException and Exception handling inside ExecuteBatchScan.
Report cancellation or failure through the existing RunOnUi/ProgressText path before clearing scanning state.
Add a focused test or injectable ScanBatchExecutionService path if the existing ViewModel construction permits it without broad refactoring.
acceptance: A batch-level exception sets a user-visible failure message.
Cancellation remains reported as cancellation, not as a generic error.
The scanning flag and commands are still reset exactly once.
tasks.packaging_considered: not applicable; no package layout change expected
tasks.deploy_considered: not applicable; repository has no evidenced external deploy workflow
compatibility_notes: No public API, archive schema, installer, or service contract change is expected.

tasks.title: Guard net6 package requests from staging the net8-only service under a net6 package path
evidence: scripts/pack.ps1 accepts -Framework and stages output under artifacts/packages/<Configuration>/<Runtime>/<Framework>.
scripts/pack.ps1 publishes the service with hard-coded net8.0-windows unless -SkipService is set.
docs/development/operations.md documents that net6.0-windows package commands must use -SkipService because NtfsAudit.Service targets net8.0-windows only.
impact: A manual scripts\pack.ps1 -Framework net6.0-windows invocation without -SkipService can produce a package directory labeled net6.0-windows while containing a net8 service.
The CI path avoids this with -SkipService, but the script itself does not enforce the documented constraint.
recommended_action: Add an explicit guard in scripts/pack.ps1 that fails when -Framework net6.0-windows is used with service packaging enabled.
Keep CI behavior unchanged by preserving its existing -SkipService call.
Treat this as packaging behavior and verify pack outputs before merging.
acceptance: scripts\pack.ps1 -Framework net6.0-windows fails with a clear message unless -SkipService is supplied.
scripts\pack.ps1 -Framework net6.0-windows -SkipService still produces App and Viewer packages.
Default net8 packaging and CI package steps remain unchanged.
tasks.packaging_considered: applicable; this item changes package-script behavior and output validation
tasks.deploy_considered: not applicable; repository has no evidenced external deploy workflow
compatibility_notes: This is a packaging-script compatibility change; manual callers relying on mixed net6 path plus net8 service output would receive a clear failure instead.

tasks.title: Consolidate scan-derived export filename generation across app, batch, and service flows
evidence: src/NtfsAudit.App/ViewModels/MainViewModel.ScanExecution.cs contains BuildScanNameFromRoot/SanitizeFileName for UI export defaults.
src/NtfsAudit.Core/Services/ScanBatchExecutionService.cs contains another BuildScanNameFromRoot/SanitizeFileName implementation for per-root archives.
src/NtfsAudit.Service/ScanWorker.cs contains a third BuildScanNameFromRoot implementation for service-mode archives.
impact: Filename behavior can drift between UI, local batch archives, and service archives.
Fixes such as collision handling must be duplicated unless filename generation is centralized.
recommended_action: After NRT-002, move scan-name and unique archive path generation into a shared NtfsAudit.Core service/helper.
Replace the duplicate local implementations with calls to the shared helper.
Keep user-facing default names stable unless a specific collision requires suffixing.
acceptance: There is one shared implementation for scan-name sanitization used by the relevant flows.
Existing export default names remain unchanged for non-collision cases.
Tests cover at least drive-root, local folder, UNC share, and duplicate-name cases.
tasks.packaging_considered: not applicable unless package-script behavior is touched
tasks.deploy_considered: not applicable; repository has no evidenced external deploy workflow
compatibility_notes: No archive schema or installer behavior change is expected; user-visible default filenames should remain compatible.
